declarations-function.name: meta.definition.function.swift
declarations-function.end: (?<=\})|$(?# functions in protocol declarations or generated interfaces have no body)

declarations-function-initializer.name: meta.definition.function.initializer.swift
declarations-function-initializer.begin: (?<!\.)\b(init[?!]*(?# only one is valid, but we want the in⇥ snippet to produce something that looks good))\s*(?=\(|<)

declarations-generic-parameter-clause.name: meta.generic-parameter-clause.swift
declarations-generic-parameter-clause.end: >|(?=[^\w\d:<>\s,=&`])(?# characters besides these are never valid in a generic param list -- even if it's not really a valid clause, we should stop trying to parse it if we see one of them.)

declarations-protocol-protocol-initializ.name: meta.definition.function.initializer.swift
declarations-protocol-protocol-initializ.begin: (?<!\.)\b(init[?!]*(?# only one is valid, but we want the in⇥ snippet to produce something that looks good))\s*(?=\(|<)

literals-regular-expression-literal-back.match:
(?x)
(\(\*)
(?:
  (ACCEPT|FAIL|F|MARK(?=:)|(?=:)|COMMIT|PRUNE|SKIP|THEN)
    (?:(:)([^)]+))?
  | (?:(LIMIT_(?:DEPTH|HEAP|MATCH))(=)(\d+))
  | (
      CRLF | CR | ANYCRLF | ANY | LF | NUL
      | BSR_ANYCRLF | BSR_UNICODE
      | NOTEMPTY_ATSTART | NOTEMPTY
      | NO_AUTO_POSSESS | NO_DOTSTAR_ANCHOR
      | NO_JIT | NO_START_OPT | UTF | UCP
    )
)
(\))
